notice: This Investor Charter sets out the vision, mission, rights of investors, service standards, and grievance redressal framework of Innovate Securities Private Limited — a SEBI-registered Stock Broker, CDSL Depository Participant, and AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-42505). This charter is published in compliance with SEBI Circular dated June 11, 2021, which mandates all SEBI-registered intermediaries to publish an Investor Charter on their website.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.body: To be a trusted partner in financial growth — empowering investors with transparent, compliant, and investor-first access to capital markets for over three decades and beyond.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.body: To deliver seamless investment services across equities, mutual funds, bonds, FDs, and NCDs — backed by SEBI and AMFI compliance, clear disclosures, and responsive grievance redressal — so every investor can make informed decisions with confidence.

services.heading: Part B — Services Provided to Investors

items.title: Stock Broking & Depository
items.detail: NSE & BSE trading · CDSL demat services

items.title: Right to Scheme Documents
items.body: Receive SID, SAI, and KIM of any recommended scheme before investing — free of charge.

items.title: Right to Account Statement
items.body: Receive Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) on request within 5 working days.

items.title: Right to Timely Proceeds
items.body: Receive redemption proceeds within T+3 days and dividend within 30 days of record date.

items.title: Right to KYC Update
items.body: Update KYC details (address, bank, nominee) at any time — processed within 30 days.

items.title: Right to Nomination
items.body: Register, change, or cancel nomination for all folio holdings at any time.

items.title: Right to Grievance Redressal
items.body: Receive complaint acknowledgement within 3 working days and resolution within 15 working days.

items.title: Right to Escalate
items.body: Escalate unresolved complaints to AMFI IGRC, SEBI SCORES, and SMART ODR without restriction.

items.title: Right to Commission Info
items.body: View trail commission paid to Innovate Securities on your investments in your monthly CAS statement.

items.title: Right to Vote
items.body: Vote on fundamental attribute changes of any scheme you are invested in — SEBI mandated.

items.title: Right to Direct Plan Info
items.body: Be informed about Direct Plans as an alternative — lower TER, no distributor commission.

commitments.heading: Part D — Our Commitments to Investors
items: Conduct investor risk profiling before every first recommendation and annual review thereafter.
Recommend only products suitable to the investor’s risk profile, goals, and investment horizon.
Disclose all commissions and conflicts of interest proactively — never hide remuneration.
Never recommend unnecessary switches to generate additional commission (no churning).
Provide SID, SAI, and KIM free of charge before any investment decision.
Maintain complete records of all client interactions and recommendations for minimum 8 years.
Provide clear and accurate information — never mislead investors about returns or risks.
Acknowledge every complaint within 3 working days and resolve within 15 working days.
Facilitate escalation to AMFI, SEBI SCORES, or SMART ODR without any obstruction.

dosDonts.heading: Part E — Dos & Don’ts for Investors

dos.heading: DOs — Best Practices
items: Always complete KYC before investing
Read SID, SAI, KIM before every investment
Invest based on your risk profile and goals
Verify ARN of your distributor at amfiindia.com
Check CAS monthly for portfolio and commissions
Update nominee details for all folios
Keep your bank and contact details updated
Invest for the long term — avoid panic redemptions

donts.heading: DON’Ts — Avoid These
items: Do not invest based on past returns alone
Do not share OTP, folio, or login with anyone
Do not invest in unregistered schemes or chit funds
Do not fall for guaranteed return promises
Do not sign blank forms or POA unnecessarily
Do not ignore scheme fundamental change notices
Do not make investments beyond your risk capacity
Do not delay KYC update after change in details

tat.heading: Part F — Service & Grievance Turnaround Times (TAT)

rows.description: Full written resolution from Innovate Securities GRO
On-demand CAS via CAMS / KFintech / MF Central
Credit to registered bank from AMC
Address, bank, nominee update processed by KRA
Effective from next SIP date after applicable notice
Email / SMS confirmation from AMC / RTA
